Project Peanut, Project Skye, Project Loch
status_as_of_cutoff: County public information says Google had begun building a Bermuda Hundred campus and had bought two additional properties, but the county records located do not establish a rezoning vote, final site-plan approval, building permit, certificate of occupancy, or energization for the portfolio.

actions.action_type: government project update / construction status reported by company
actions.result_status: County article reported that Google had announced a data-center campus and that a company spokesperson said it had already broken ground on a 300-plus-acre Bermuda Hundred site. The article records no county vote or permit approval.
actions.access_caveat: Official article attributes the groundbreaking statement to Google; it is not an approval instrument.
actions.evidence_note: Construction-status report, not a construction permit or certificate of occupancy.

actions.result_status: A resident public comment referenced 2700 Bermuda Hundred Road, Google, and Peanut LLC and raised concerns about nondisclosure and public notice. The published comments do not show a Board action or vote on the project.
actions.access_caveat: This is a public-comments file, not minutes or an approval packet.
actions.evidence_note: Public comment is not a land-use decision.

actions.government_body: Chesterfield County Community Development / plan review
actions.result_status: Weekly active-plan review record routed PROJECT PEANUT EP, case 25PR1323, plan type PA REG, for review on January 23; the record's final-status field was blank/NA. No approval can be inferred.
actions.access_caveat: Weekly review list is an administrative routing/status document, not a final site-plan decision.
actions.evidence_note: Site-plan review is land-use administration; it is not a building permit.
